patterns.note: Asymmetrical, full-bleed image grids are used extensively to showcase work, creating a dynamic and visually rich experience.
Overlapping, large-scale typography is used for the hero and main section titles, creating a bold, almost sculptural brand presence.
A neutral base palette of black, white, and subtle greys provides a clean canvas for vibrant, full-color photography to be the primary visual focus.
The large 'VIV' hero text and 'Artist management + production' tagline act as a sticky or slow-parallaxing overlay, while a continuous, full-bleed grid of images scrolls underneath it.
Content is organized into distinct sections featuring either dynamic image galleries or clean, text-heavy informational blocks with clear headings.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, bold, static or slow-parallaxing text element (which is also a video hero) positioned over a full-bleed, continuously scrolling grid of diverse images, creating a layered visual effect.
Content sections utilize a flexible, asymmetrical grid layout for displaying images, allowing for varied aspect ratios and visual interest without strict alignment.
Typography establishes strong visual hierarchy through extreme size contrast, using oversized, bold sans-serif for key statements and a more restrained sans-serif for body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a denser, but still open, feel within image grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost sculptural use of the 'VIV' logo as a central, fixed or slow-parallaxing element, acting as a window or overlay through which a dynamic, full-bleed stream of high-quality, diverse imagery scrolls. This creates a strong brand presence and a highly visual, immersive experience.
